Stemlab ist nicht nur eine von nur  fünf europäischen von der AABB (American Association of Blood Banks) international akkreditierten Familienbanken für Nabelschnurblut, sondern auch die einzige in Europa, die diese Zertifizierung auch für Nabelschnurgewebe erhalten hat. In der Schweiz ist Stemlab durch die Swissmedic und das Bundesamt für Gesundheit zertifiziert. 

Gegründet von einer Gruppe von Wissenschaftlern und Fachleuten auf dem Gebiet der Life Sciences, ist es Stemlabs Mission, die bestehenden und zukünftigen Behandlungsmöglichkeiten mit Stammzellen zu erweitern, um einen aktiven Beitrag zur Entwicklung der Wissenschaft auf dem Gebiet der Zelltherapie zu leisten.
Derzeit haben bereits mehr als 100.000 Eltern Stemlab  die Verantwortung anvertraut, die Zellen ihrer Kindern zu lagern.

Die erste Stammzelltransplantation mit einer bei Stemlab gelagertern Probe fand 2007 in Portugal statt. Seitdem wurden 9 weitere Kinder mit den bei Stemlab gelagerten Proben behandelt, eines gegen Leukämie, die anderen innerhalb einer klinischen Studie der Duke-Universität (USA) zur Behandlung von Kindern mit Zerebralparese.

Mit dem fortgesetzten Fokus auf Forschung und Entwicklung konnte Stemlab bereits 4 Patente im Bereich der Stammzelltherapie registrieren. Eines dieser Patente bezieht sich z.B. auf eine Gelformulierung mit Stammzellen aus Nabelschnurblut zur Behandlung chronischer Wunden bei Diabetikern.

Alicon was liquidated in 2010 and the know-how and the proprietary rights passed to Prionatis AG in Alpnach, CH-140.3.003.415-2, Aktiengesellschaft (SHAB Nr. 58 vom 25.03.2013, S. 0, Publ. 7119542). GENFIT is a pioneer in liver disease research and development with a rich history and strong scientific heritage spanning more than two decades. Its capacity to develop high potential assets, from early-stages to late development and pre-commercialization stages, is illustrated through the successful 52-week readout of its Phase 3 trial (ELATIVE) evaluating elafibranor in Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC). 

Today, GENFIT has a diversified R&D pipeline covering several therapeutic areas: five programs in acute on chronic liver failure (ACLF) are in clinical stages (Phase 2) and pre-clinical stages, including hepatic encephalopathy (HE), one of the main complications of ACLF; a Phase 2 clinical program targeting cholangiocarcinoma; and a preclinical program targeting urea cycle disorders (UCD) and organic acidemias (OA). GENFIT’s pipeline also includes a diagnostic franchise focused on Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH, formerly known as nonalcoholic steatohepatitis or NASH) and ammonia. GENFIT has facilities in Lille and Paris (France), Zurich (Switzerland) and Cambridge, MA (USA). 

GENFIT is a publicly traded company listed on compartment B of Euronext’s regulated market in Paris ( Euronext: GNFT). In 2021, IPSEN became one of GENFIT’s largest shareholders and holds 8% of the company’s share capital.

Name: Jungbunzlauer
Description:
Jungbunzlauer is a leading producer of high-quality, sustainable ingredients from natural sources, serving industries from food and beverage, to nutrition, health, home and personal care, among others. Leading the way in developing naturally better ingredients that enhance everyday life, we are a trusted partner offering a diverse portfolio of texturants, acidulants, sweeteners, minerals, and tailored solutions to meet our customers’ evolving needs. 

Headquartered in Basel, Switzerland, with state-of-the-art facilities including large-scale fermentation operations across Europe and North America, we proudly serve more than 130 countries worldwide. Founded more than 150 years ago, Jungbunzlauer has grown into a CHF 1.3 billion company, driven by nearly 1,400 dedicated colleagues committed to a healthier, more sustainable future. 

See our community guidelines here: https://www.jungbunzlauer.com/en/company/services/linkedin-community-guidelines

Name: Campus Biotech
Description: Campus Biotech is a pioneering life sciences and biotechnology hub in the heart of Geneva’s Health Valley. It fosters innovation, research, and collaboration, bringing together the brightest minds, institutions, and businesses to transform ideas into life-changing discoveries.

Name: LifeMine Therapeutics
Description: LifeMine Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company pioneering Top-Down Drug DiscoveryTM, which leverages evolutionary insights from fungi to unearth next-generation precision medicines. LifeMine’s data-immersive platform integrates the latest advancements in human genetics and genomics, bioinformatics, machine learning and synthetic biology. LifeMine’s lead program, LIFE-001, is a novel, precision-engineered, long-acting calcineurin inhibitor being developed for multiple immunologic disorders and organ transplantation.

Name: ImmunOs Therapeutics AG
Description:
ImmunOs Therapeutics AG is developing the next generation of immunotherapies that have a role in the innate immune system for cancer and autoimmune diseases.  The company is developing therapies that not only have direct anti-tumor effects but also remodel the tumor microenvironment to enhance the efficacy of existing immunotherapies. 

This portfolio of next generation, novel immunomodulatory proteins target diverse and key immunoregulatory receptors.  Our lead program iosH2, now advancing to Phase 1 studies, is a multi-functional fusion protein that blocks specific LILRB (leukocyte immunoglobulin-like) receptors and thereby activates anti-tumor responses in multiple cancers with monotherapy and in combination with checkpoint inhibitors (CTLA-4, PD-1, PD-L1, CD47) and costimulatory agonists (e.g. 4-1BB).

Name: Noema Pharma
Description:
Noema Pharma is a biotech company developing groundbreaking therapies to address the most disabling symptoms in orphan conditions of the brain and nervous system.
Noema’s research and development is focused on understanding and meeting patient needs using our novel therapies.

Name: Scailyte
Description:
True precision medicine through single-cell science. 

Scailyte, a pioneer in AI-driven biomarker discovery from single-cell omics data, has leveraged its proprietary AI platform, ScaiVision, to analyze over 60 million single-cell profiles.  The company's extensive network of clinical partners and access to unique patient cohorts in oncology and auto-immunity have led to the development of multiple patent-pending biomarker signatures. Headquartered in Basel, Switzerland, Scailyte collaborates with clinical-stage biotech and pharma companies worldwide, enabling biomarker-driven drug development and paving the way for precision medicine to become a reality.

If you want to partner with, reach out to contact@scailyte.com
 
More information about our company, technology & services you can find on our website - https://scailyte.com

Name: ABIM - Annual Biocontrol Industry Meeting
Description:
As the unrivalled meeting place for the biocontrol industry, ABIM is internationally recognised as the venue at which to discover and unveil new products, to discuss market opportunities, to present new research, to learn about the latest regulatory situation and to liaise with fellow professionals from all over the world.

During the three days over 2000 delegates from 60 countries representing more than 500 companies and organisations from all over the globe can be expected to attend to network and exchange experiences and obtain information on the latest products and developments on the world market.

Held in the Congress Center Basel each October.

Name: Alithea Genomics
Description: RNA sequencing at scale.

Name: bNovate Technologies SA
Description:
Safe Water. Anytime. Anywhere.

bNovate Technologies SA develops robust and innovative instruments to set new standards in the field of rapid microbiological monitoring for pharmaceutical and drinking water. 

Thanks to our proprietary and fully automated industrial flow cytometry technology you don't need to wait 3 days to get your water microbiology results back, our instruments will do it in only 20 minutes!

Name: ATANIS Biotech AG
Description:
ATANIS Biotech AG has developed a novel functional cell based assay that massively simplifies the diagnosis of allergies and can predict treatment success of therapies. This test is used to assess safety and efficacy of potential new drug candidates for allergy treatment. It is being developed for an upcoming commercialization in the clinic.

Contact us at: info@atanis-biotech.com

Name: lino Biotech AG - A Miltenyi Biotec Company
Description: Lino Biotech AG, a Miltenyi Biotec Company, advances drug discovery with its label-free focal molography platform, enabling real-time, multiplexed biomolecular interaction analysis in complex biological samples like human serum and living cells. By measuring interactions in their native environment, its MACS Matchmaker system delivers precise kinetic and affinity data, especially for high-throughput DNA-encoded library (DEL) hit validation. From antibody screening to GPCR analysis, we provide high-sensitivity solutions that accelerate therapeutic development with unmatched biological relevance.

Name: AgroSustain SA
Description:
AgroSustain – a one-stop-shop solution for biological plant protection. We aim to reduce food waste and support organic food production by developing farm to fork solutions, like biological fungicides and coatings.

AgroSustain has developed a pipeline of plant-derived antifungal compounds against broad range of agronomically important fungal pathogens present in pre- (in the field) and post-harvest (in storage). AgroSustain’s first product, called AgroShelf+, extends shelf life of vegetables & fruits infected with mostly spread molds.

AgroSustain’s B2B customers, food distributors & producers with post-harvest storage facilities, that value more the effectiveness of the product on crops rather than the price. Post-harvest application of AgroShelf+ on stored perishable food can be done with spray, dipping or fogging in storage facilities  or packing houses with no to minimal installation costs.

Name: Anjarium Biosciences AG
Description:
Anjarium Biosciences is a cell and gene therapy tools and technology company headquartered in Switzerland.

Our mission is to enable researchers and manufacturers to accelerate the discovery and delivery cycle of new and evolving genetic medicines. Our technology enables our partners to meet biology’s greatest challenges with increasingly flexible and customizable DNA constructs in pursuit of better human health.  

We offer a range of products to support research, development, and commercialization of genetic medicines. Our enzymatic, cell-free platform enables Anjarium to offer pure, infinitely customizable, stable synthetic DNA constructs at scale for use across AAV, mRNA, Lentivirus and other applications.

Name: Athebio AG
Description: Athebio enables innovative drug developers to create superior targeted therapeutics of advanced efficacy and safety by providing them with tailor-made “plug and play” DARPins as building blocks, working together in a co-creative space, and supporting them with in-depth expertise.

Name: Microsynth AG
Description:
Microsynth (founded in 1989) is a leading company in Europe in the field of DNA/RNA syntheses & analyses. The main activities are divided into the following three business areas:

1. DNA/RNA SYNTHESES
›DNA/RNA oligonucleotides (unmodified, modified, various purity grades) for various R&D applications 
› Primers and probes (e.g. OEM kit production) for molecular diagnostics 
› antisense oligonucleotides as well as siRNAs for drug discovery

2. DNA/RNA ANALYSES AND SEQUENCING
› DNA Sanger sequencing of all types (incl. GMP sequencing) 
› Next generation sequencing (de novo & re-sequencing at the genome level, RNA-Seq, metagenome and amplicon sequencing, bioinformatics, etc.)
› PCR, qPCR and digital PCR 
› Genotyping (fragment length analysis, cell line characterization, STR marker development, GBS)
› DNA/RNA isolations (all sources, including high-throughput format)

3. CONTRACT RESEARCH/OUTSOURCING
› Assay establishment & validation (e.g. IVD, animal and food diagnostics)
› Biological testing (e.g. lot release mRNA vaccines)
› Gene editing/gene therapy (e.g. CRISPR on/off target GxP analyses, rAAV characterization)

Microsynth employs >100 people and has branch offices in Germany (Microsynth Seqlab), France (Microsynth France), Austria (Microsynth Austria) and Switzerland (ecogenics). Microsynth is ISO 9001:2015-, ISO 13485:2016- (oligonucleotide synthesis, kit production), ISO/IEC 17025:2017 (STS 0429) - (NGS, Sanger sequencing, fragment length analysis) and GMP certified (Sanger sequencing).

We’re truly proud to be a pillar of scientific progress in pharma, biotech, and medicine. Since being founded in 1989, we’ve been incredibly passionate about the synthesis and analysis of nucleic acids - whether it is for basic research, diagnostic, or therapeutic applications. We act quickly and we’re easy to do business with, and we always show respect for the environment in everything we do.

Name: Navignostics AG
Description:
Our mission is to identify the ideal treatment to battle each cancer patient’s disease and reduce suffering throughout their journey.

At Navignostics we characterize tumors using spatial single-cell proteomics. We use our unique capabilities to identify a cancer treatment that will optimally fight each patient’s tumor. We also accelerate cancer drug development by providing key insights into drug mechanisms and tumor features for companion diagnostic development.

Our highly robust and reliable technology and our leading data analytics position us ideally to enable precision cancer diagnostics for patients and to provide services to pharma and biotech partners.

This way we help people suffering from cancer by making more drugs available and by finding the right one for every patient.

Name: Novigenix AI
Description:
Novigenix AI is a TechBio that powers precision medicine through its proprietary AI-enabled liquid biopsy mRNA platform, LITOSeek, to map immune-response dynamics across disease onset and progression—turning biology into actionable insights for therapy development.

Our AI-enabled ISO-13485 certified RNA analytic platform delivers ImmunoPD biomarkers, insights into mechanism of action and resistance, and early markers for severe toxicity to accelerate clinical development. These scalable solutions are currently adopted in a number of FDA clinical trials providing actionable insights across therapeutic modalities including ADCs, radioligand therapy, cellular therapies, therapeutic vaccines, and immunotherapies.

The LITOSeekTM Liquid ImmunoTranscriptOmic platform has been optimized for mapping the response of patient immune system to onset of disease and therapeutic intervention. Proprietary analytical pipelines integrate patient multi-omics data with advanced Machine Learning and artificial intelligence approaches for early detection of disease, development of novel therapeutics, and drug target discovery.

Name: Engimmune Therapeutics
Description:
Engimmune is an immunotherapy company utilising cutting-edge methods for the development of T-cell receptor (TCR)-based immunotherapies including T cell therapies and biologics. By applying our unique protein engineering toolbox we have established and continue to develop proprietary high-throughput technology platforms enabling the discovery of highly potent and safe TCR-based cell therapies and biotherapeutics, thus covering the entire TCR discovery value chain. 

Operating as a platform technology and product development company, our vision is to become a globally leading provider of best-in-class TCR-based therapeutics for the treatment of serious human diseases with high unmet medical need, with a particular focus on oncology.  

Engimmune is based in a brand new science park in Allschwill, Basel in Switzerland

Name: Swiss Biotech Center
Description:
The Swiss Biotech Center is non-for-profit, self-sustained company, acting as a competence center in Life Sciences open to innovative companies and academic researchers and developers.

Our offer spans two complimentary domains: 
- In-Vitro Diagnostics, with a specific focus on Point-Of-Care Tests (POCT)
- Biopharmaceuticals.

We provide customized services of development, a top-notch laboratory and infrastructure, including a cGMP compliant clean room for the Biopharmaceutics activity and a lab dedicated to lateral flow technology. In addition, Swiss Biotech Center has assembled an extensive network of partners to help our customers developing the new life sciences products and technologies that will shape our future.

Located in Monthey, in the canton of Valais in Switzerland, we are at the heart of the Swiss “Health Valley”.

Name: Neovii
Description:
Neovii is a global leader in polyclonal antibody immunosuppressive therapy used in organ transplantation and hematology/oncology.

Our lead product, Grafalon, has been used for over 30 years to treat patients and is available in more than 40 countries world wide. It has approval for use in immunosuppressive therapies for prevention of graft- versus- host disease in stem cell transplantation, prevention and treatment of rejection in solid organ transplantation and in treatment of aplastic anemia.

Name: Versameb AG
Description:
Versameb AG is a privately held biotechnology company focusing on discovering and developing innovative RNA-based drugs for modulation of protein expression, including the ability to simultaneously influence several therapeutic targets, in a controlled manner, with one molecular construct, and cellular targeting. 

Based in Basel and fully operational from 2018, the company is led by an experienced scientific and leadership team with proven expertise in drug discovery and development from lab bench to patient. Versameb’s proprietary technology platform, VERSagile, optimizes the application of functional RNA in different disease contexts – making RNA druggable in new therapeutic areas others have been unable to solve. The pipeline includes lead candidate programs in Stress Urinary Incontinence (SUI) and solid tumors. Versameb is working towards the completion of a first in-human/proof-of-concept clinical study while advancing its platform.

Name: BGG
Description:
BGG is a global leader in the development and purification of high quality active natural plant ingredients for the dietary supplement, pharmaceutical, personal care, and food and beverage industries.

Founded in 1995, BGG employs a staff of approximately 400, has 6 production sites, international branches in North America, Japan, China and Switzerland and manages sales in more than 70 countries.

BGG selects raw materials, which are primarily from wild-crafted, organic, and from non-GMO sources, whenever possible. From these we produce health products and nutritional solutions that aid and enhance people's well-being and quality of life.

Key products include: 

AstaZine, Natural Astaxanthin from Haemattococus Pluvialis algae farmed in world’s First Organically Certified Astaxanthin Farm.

ApplePhenon, a patented highly concentrated natural polyphenol extract produced from wild unripe apples using proprietary technology. Applephenon, supported by 16 clinical studies and more than 50 publication, has been clinically validated in 4 out of 5 of the typical risk factors for metabolic syndrome and in the prevention of seasonal allergies and sports endurance.

TheraPrimeE: BGG is one of the major worldwide producers of Tocotrienols extracted from Rice, Palm and Annatto that we offer in form of oils or water dispersible powders.

MyrtiPRO: Bilberry Extract from Wild Scandinavian bilberry fruit.

ThinOGen: Fucoxanthin, Thermogenic weight loss ingredient from seaweed.

Licorice based products such as licorice powders and blocks, licorice flavonoids and licorice derivatives (monoammonium glycyrrhizinate, dipotassium glycyrrhizate, 18-β-glycyrrhetinic acid...).

Steviol glycosides based products such as Reb A and D, managing the entire manufacturing process from raw material cultivation, extraction, compound isolation and finished product purification.


BGG is ISO9001, ISO22000 and GMP certified.

Name: SwissDeCode
Description:
SwissDeCode helps farmers and food manufacturers to grow and produce high quality products by offering a variety of rapid, on-site DNA testing solutions. 

We help brands launch new premium products faster and companies to transition to more sustainable value chain practices. 

Get in touch to discuss your testing needs.

Name: LubioScience
Description:
We are your go-to partner for life science reagents in Switzerland. More than 5 Million products from 130+ suppliers - whatever you are looking for, you'll find it at Lubio.
With 20 years of experience in marketing & sales of Life Science reagents in Switzerland and Europe, we have a loyal customer base and an excellent relationship with our suppliers and brands. With our experienced and motivated team we aim to provide an efficient, reliable and professional service to our clients.

Name: Matterhorn Biosciences
Description: Matterhorn is a leader in developing a new class of MR1 directed cell therapy targeting cancer through its proprietary M-TCR cell therapy platform.

Name: FimmCyte
Description: First disease modifying treatment for Endometriosis

Name: Embion Technologies
Description:
We commercialize the next generation in biomass processing technology to meet the planet’s growing demand in nutrition, materials and energy. 

Our aim is to become the technology leader for producing natural, sustainable, low emissions and high functionality products from biomass across all industries, starting with nutrition, where our team develops, produces and markets the next generation bioactive nutritional ingredients and solutions with global partners.

Our novel technology approach accelerates the development of sustainable products, while significantly reducing cost and time-to-market. 

With our one-of-a-kind technology, we catalyzes the future towards a circular bioeconomy.

Name: KetoSwiss AG
Description: KetoSwiss is a Swiss biotechnology company located in Basel, that develops and clinically tests a novel nutraceutical/medical food for the dietary preventive therapy of higher-frequency migraines and possibly other related neurological diseases characterized by a metabolic dysfunction (such as Alzheimer's disease). The lead product’s active substance is an endogenous metabolite – a Ketone body, that can be used by the human brain as an alternative source of fuel to glucose, when glucose utilization or transport is compromised.

Name: Altium
Description:
Altium was established in 1997 to provide tailored, turnkey solutions, primarily for the life sciences and analytical chemistry industries. We provide innovative answers to client requirements, from clinical and laboratory project management, the biotechnology, agriculture and pharmaceutical industries to academia.

As a privately held investment company with a head office near the city of Lausanne in Switzerland, we have subsidiaries in Poland, the Czech Republic, Croatia, Bosnia & Herzegovina, Romania and Turkey, with third party representation in Azerbaijan and Kosovo. We also maintain a close network of associates throughout Central and Eastern Europe, the Middle East and Africa.

Name: ender diagnostics ag
Description: ender pursues a holistic approach that focuses on the health of humans, animals and the environment. Our diagnostic screening solutions and complementary services make it possible to make informed decisions at an early stage and take the necessary measures. Through this preventive approach, we help to identify and contain diseases at an early stage, reduce unnecessary suffering, open up new perspectives and enable economic and ecological solutions. As a Swiss SME, we thus make an important contribution to promoting health.

Name: Catran GmbH
Description:
The purpose of the company is to provide business consulting for biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies in the areas of drug development, biomarkers, experimental medicine and translational research with a focus on neurosciences and rare diseases. Furthermore, the company offers services in connection with clinical studies including their implementation, medical monitoring and regulatory strategy.

Zweck der Gesellschaft ist die Erbringung von Unternehmensberatung für Biotechnologie- und Pharmaunternehmen in den Bereichen Arzneimittelentwicklung, Biomarker, experimentelle Medizin und Transportforschung mit Schwerpunkt auf Neurowissenschaften und seltenen Krankheiten. Im Weiteren bietet das Unternehmen Dienstleistungen an im Zusammenhang mit klinischen Studien inklusive deren Durchführung, medizinische Überwachung und Regulierungsstra.

Name: ACHIKO
Description:
Achiko AG (SIX: ACHI.SW) is developing disruptive diagnostic solutions that puts people first. Invented by Dr Michael Edel, the company’s flagship product is a fast, friendly, affordable and accurate Covid-19 test with a companion app. The test and companion app were launched in Indonesia in mid-2021 and AptameXTM received the CE Mark in the European Union in May 2022.

Achiko creates and develops aptamer-based diagnostics through its biotechnology division, AptameXTM and companion health apps via its digital mobile health technology division, Teman SehatTM. The AptameXTM DNA aptamer tests can be rapidly chemically synthesised, are cost-effective and have wide potential across multiple disease diagnostics. Leveraging AptameXTM and Teman SehatTM, Achiko aims to deliver fast, accurate and affordable diagnostic testing for a range of pathogenic diseases and therapeutic indications in the rapidly evolving healthcare diagnostics field.

Headquartered in Zurich, Achiko has offices in Jakarta and Singapore.

Name: NovaGo Therapeutics
Description: NovaGo’s fully human monoclonal antibodies have the potential to become a safe and effective treatment in central nervous system indications.  NovaGo’s proprietary antibodies block the function of Nogo-A, one of the most potent and well-studied vascular and nerve growth inhibitors.

Name: Centaura
Description:
Centaura is a team of ambitious scientists who have successfully designed and developed a revolutionary genome engineering platform capable of changing the biotech landscape.

Our powerful, versatile, and cost-effective technology allows for multiple clinical and industrial applications.

We can introduce large DNA sequences into cells reliably, safely, and without eliciting an immune response. The technology of genome engineering without cutting the genome itself that could be used ubiquitously is nearer than you think.

Name: SaferWorldbyDesign
Description:
SaferWorldbyDesign engages a global consortium of dedicated innovators with the shared goal of advancing the science and technology necessary to protect the wellness and safety of consumers and the environment. Our part in this goal is to support the design of intelligent, effective, and safer products by providing integrated solutions to test and assess individual ingredients and formulations. 

Our solution-oriented platforms, solutions, and products integrate in silico and in vitro methods which support the design and testing of intelligent, safer products using new approach methods in toxicology and next-generation risk assessment. Our partners bring expertise in the best emerging research methods in toxicology, Artificial Intelligence, biology, chemistry, risk assessment, and computer science to provide a one-stop-shop for designing a safer world.

Name: Salveo Biotechnology SA
Description:
Salveo Biotechnology, operational structure of Salveo Holding, is a Swiss private laboratory specialized in stem cells cryopreservation and cell culture. Created in 2011, it is also a high-tech platform made up of experts in the service of regenerative medicine.

Based in Geneva, our laboratory is now helping to develop the future of medicine with its own clean room and the latest state of the art equipment.

Salveo Biotechnology is also present in Italy, Spain, Romania and Ukraine.

Name: YMC ChromaCon
Description:
YMC ChromaCon has a unique range of process and process control patents and together with our scale-up partner, YMC America, we offer chromatography solutions from laboratory to GMP process scale.

Our vision is to improve the efficiency of bioprocessing by providing best-in-class chromatography equipment to develop and manufacture the next-generation of chemical and biological medicines using continuous manufacturing technology. Continuous manufacturing offers 30-50% reduction in CAPEX and OPEX compared to conventional batch manufacturing.

We are unique in providing a twin-column FPLC development system, the Contichrom CUBE, for the continuous purification of peptides, oligonucleotides, mAbs, and small molecules. The Contichrom CUBE has multiple process capabilities allowing our customers to choose the best purification process for any given purification challenge. Chromatographic processes developed on the Contichrom CUBE can be scaled directly to any Contichrom TWIN, our line of GMP capable continuous manufacturing systems.

ChromaCon AG was founded in 2008 and acquired by YMC in 2019. Within the YMC Group, YMC ChromaCon is the center of excellence for developing and commercializing continuous chromatographic process technologies.
YMC ChromaCon is based in Switzerland but has a global footprint.

Name: InCephalo
Description: InCephalo develops exclusively local treatments for neurological diseases, with a focus on cancers in the brain (primary brain cancers as well as secondary brain cancers). The proprietary Compartment Lock technology, also called  C-Lock, retains biologics, that are applied locally behind the blood brain barrier, in the central nervous system (CNS) and once they leave the CNS, degrades them rapidly in the systemic compartment. Thereby it significantly improves local CNS therapy, a challenging task with regards to achieving high local concentration (for efficacy) and low systemic footprint (to reduce potential side effects). Especially the peripheral side effects still limit various promising candidates for the treatment of brain cancer or other neurological diseases.

Name: Onena Medicines
Description: Onena Medicines is a biopharmaceutical company with a pipeline of first-in-class antibody medicines to treat recurrent and metastatic cancers and selected rare diseases. Onena’s drugs neutralize a new class of secreted ancient growth factors, conserved across species, called Dual SMAD Inhibiting Proteins (DSIPs), that program cancer cells to grow and resist chemotherapy. Blocking DSIPs, as demonstrated in-vivo by Onena, simultaneously reactivates physiological TGF-β and BMP signaling and elicits cellular reprogramming, resulting in cancer cells accepting environmental cell death signals from BMPs and Activins. Onena has developed a proprietary AI-centric antibody drug discovery platform that rapidly generates anti-DSIP neutralizing antibodies, even when no crystal structure of the antigen is available. OMED-101, Onena’s anti-LEFTY1/2 lead candidate antibody, has demonstrated broad efficacy against breast, colorectal and brain cancers without observable toxicities in preclinical models. Through its unique platform, Onena Medicines has discovered several DSIPs and aims to advance multiple neutralizing DSIP antibody drugs into clinical development in the next three years.

Name: VITARIS AG
Description:
VITARIS beliefert Labors der Mikrobiologie und Zellkultur mit qualitativen Geräten sowie
hochwertigem Verbrauchsmaterial. Der Bereich „Allgemeiner Laborbedarf“ bietet Produkte
für vielfältige Lösungen für Anwender der Life Science Branche an und dank unserer eigenen
Serviceabteilung sichern wir die Langlebigkeit Ihrer Anschaffungen.

„A Difference in Life Science“ – dieses Versprechen soll uns als Leitschnur für unser Unternehmen
dienen. Wenn sich alles gleicht, dann zählt der Unterschied. Wir möchten uns unterscheiden,
mit einem freundlicheren Kundenservice, mit Kompetenz und mit einem Einsatz, der mehr als das Übliche ist.

Alle unsere MitarbeiterInnen verfügen über langjähriges Know-how in ihrem Fachgebiet und
dadurch über die entsprechende notwendige Kompetenz. Durch laufende Weiterbildung in
Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Herstellern stellen wir sicher, dass wir kundengerechte Lösungen
anbieten und Sie kompetent beraten können. Unsere Techniker werden in den Produktionsstätten
unserer Lieferanten sorgfältig und regelmässig ausgebildet. Zudem verfügen sie
über jahrelange Praxiserfahrung und garantieren Ihnen dadurch eine hohe Servicekompetenz.

Name: Mabritec AG
Description:
- Dienstleistungen im Bereich der mikrobiologischen Diagnostik mittels Peptid Massen Fingerprinting mit MALDI-TOF MS Technologie

- Technologiepartner bei F&E-Projekten

Name: Acthera Therapeutics Ltd.
Description: ACTHERA was a Swiss biotech company founded in 2019, in liquidation since 2024. The team was developing a therapeutic platform based on a unique type of liposomes for the targeted delivery of drugs. Due to lack of funding, the decision was taken early 2024 to liquidate the company.

Name: Therachon
Description:
Therachon is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development and commercialization of innovative treatments for severe, rare conditions for which there is significant unmet medical need. We are currently advancing a pipeline of therapeutics focused on rare gastrointestinal and musculoskeletal disorders and conditions. 

Our lead product candidate, apraglutide, is a second generation, potentially best-in-class, synthetic peptide analog of glucagon-like peptide-2, or GLP-2, that is being evaluated in two Phase 2 clinical trials for the treatment of patients with short bowel syndrome, or SBS, a malabsorption disorder caused by the loss of functional small intestine. Our second product candidate, TA-46, has completed a Phase 1 clinical trial and is designed to address the root molecular cause of achondroplasia, a rare genetic condition and the most common form of short-limbed dwarfism in humans. 

View our social media community guidelines here: http://bit.ly/2TdB4Vm.

Name: healiva
Description:
Healiva`s mission is to heal life, by offering a portfolio of innovative acute and chronic wound care solutions, which are personalized and affordable. Our approach combines enzyme technology, cell therapies and medical devices. We offer end-to-end offering of wound care solutions. Our multi-pronged approach to become the go-to-provider for all wound care needs – from wound debridement to treatment of severe wounds. 

2-3% of the elderly suffer from painful venous/arterial leg ulcers and nearly 25% of diabetics may develop diabetic foot ulcers in their lifetimes. This figure set to rise with the increasing prevalence of contributing factors, including diabetes, advanced age, and obesity. This burden is also borne by healthcare systems, which spend 2% of their budgets on wound management. About ≈60% of chronic wounds remain unhealed. There remains a major gap in the current treatment paradigm. No permanent therapy for non-healing wounds currently exists. A successful regimen can prevent osteomyelitis, hospitalisation, amputation, and even death, allowing patients to re-establish their normal work/life routines. Healiva is targeting key pain-points in the patient care pathway. 

Our multifaceted customer base encompasses hospitals, medical practitioners, insurance providers and patients. We are developing a unique selling proposition for chronic wounds healing targeting the high cost of care, time to heal, requirements for frequent dressing changes and specialist medical expertise, whilst reducing wounds reoccurrence and accelerating patients’ re-establishment of normal work/life routines.

Healiva’s portfolio potentially address the growing un-met need for chronic wound care, which forms part of the global €15.6B wound care market.

Name: genknowme
Description:
Genknowme is a Swiss-based epigenetics company dedicated to unlocking the potential of DNA methylation for both longevity-focused clinical practices and advanced biomedical research. Our mission is twofold: we support clinicians in the field of longevity medicine with science-based epigenetic testing to monitor biological aging and healthspan-related biomarkers, while also serving as a trusted partner for researchers and biotech companies seeking precision DNA methylation analysis services.

By combining cutting-edge epigenomic science with robust bioinformatics, Genknowme delivers reliable, high-resolution data to support translational research, clinical development, and innovation in longevity science.

Whether you're a longevity-focused clinician, a research leader, or a biotech innovator, Genknowme provides actionable insights into how lifestyle and environment shape health at the molecular level.
We provide a novel blood test to support healthcare professionals while they coach their patients into making healthy lifestyle changes. Our test measures the impact of lifestyle on health at DNA level with unprecedented precision, and it is based on the science of epigenetics.

Name: MedXCell SA
Description: MedXCell is a European cell therapy venture builder with a strong industrial mindset and a global perspective. Our focus is on technologies, techniques or novel applications in major diseases such as cancer, autoimmune, neurological and degenerative disorders. Established in 2018, we have offices in Switzerland, the EU (France) and the US (Cambridge, MA) and a multidisciplinary expert team with entrepreneurial, clinical, operational, business development and funding capabilities.

Name: LabFinder
Description:
LabFinder is Switzerland's platform for laboratory procurement, combining product knowledge, brands and supplier discovery in one place. We simplify how laboratories, research institutions, universities and companies discover laboratory equipment, consumables and services.

Instead of searching through countless manufacturer websites and catalogues, users can explore product information, applications, selection criteria, brands, product categories and suppliers on a single platform. LabFinder helps users make informed purchasing decisions and connect directly with the right suppliers.

For manufacturers, distributors and specialist suppliers, LabFinder provides targeted visibility among laboratories actively researching products and solutions. By combining expert knowledge with supplier discovery, we create qualified business opportunities and reduce the effort required to connect buyers with the right providers.

Our mission is to make laboratory procurement smarter, faster and more transparent by bringing together knowledge, products, brands and suppliers in one central platform.

Name: mAbTree Biologics
Description: mABTree Biologics is a biotech company based in Basel, Switzerland, focused on developing affordable, innovative monoclonal antibody therapies for hematological cancers, such as myeloproliferative neoplasms (MPNs), and autoimmune diseases. Founded in 2019, mABTree aims to make cutting-edge immunotherapies more accessible to patients worldwide. Our lead product, MT-0002, is a fully human antibody targeting a unique tumor marker and has shown promising preclinical results, including tumor reduction and depletion of mutant hematopoietic stem cells in MPN models. We are preparing for clinical trials and seeking partnerships and investments to accelerate development and potential regulatory approval by 2025, with a strategy for orphan drug status to expedite availability in underserved areas of oncology and hematology.

Name: medlabdia
Description:
medlabdia is a specialized provider of laboratory, life science, and diagnostic solutions, helping laboratories scale intelligently through new equipment, validated pre-owned systems, consumables, and lifecycle support.

We support laboratories, biotech companies, diagnostics organizations, research institutes, and industrial laboratories with high-quality laboratory infrastructure designed to improve operational flexibility, productivity, and long-term performance.

Our offering includes:
 New laboratory equipment from selected innovative partners
 Professionally tested and certified pre-owned systems
 High-quality consumables and robotic tips
 Service, engineering expertise, and lifecycle support

Unlike many transactional equipment suppliers, medlabdia combines equipment, consumables, and service support into a complete lifecycle approach that helps laboratories reduce operational risk while making smarter and more sustainable CAPEX decisions.

With more than 20 years of experience, we support laboratory automation, liquid handling, molecular diagnostics, PCR/qPCR, protein purification, and analytical laboratory workflows, with strong expertise in Hamilton platforms.

Through the collaboration with our service partner, we help laboratories improve uptime, continuity, and scalability across regional and global markets.

 Regional & global support
 Service-backed laboratory solutions
 Consumables & robotic tips
 Validated pre-owned systems

www.medlabdia.com
sales@medlabdia.com

Name: FGen
Description:
FGen is an emerging Swiss company that combines biological engineering, such as synthetic biology, metabolic engineering, or non-GMO methods, with high throughput screening to design and optimize cells for biotechnological applications. Key to this process is FGen's proprietary nonoliter-reactor (NLR) platform that enables the phenotypic screening of cell libraries at rates of more than 1 million clones per day, thereby surpassing multi-well plate systems by orders of magnitude. The NLR technology enables analysis under relevant conditions (e.g. fed-batch cultivation, defined environments) and has successfully be used for production of small molecules and proteins by bacteria, yeast, fungi, and mammalian cells.
FGen uses its expertise in biological engineering and high throughput screening in collaboration with industrial partners in industrial biotech, life sciences and pharma to develop products for various markets.

Name: Seneque
Description:
Seneque is a life sciences company that brings together leading cellular scientists to advance the frontiers of health and longevity.

We transform breakthroughs in cellular science into consumer solutions that enhance healthspan, lifespan and vitality. Our portfolio of science-based consumer health brands use natural molecules to optimize the body’s NAD+ metabolism.
 
Our international research platform is undertaking an extensive in-human research program that is propelling development of our proprietary NMN-C and other synergetic molecules as NAD+ boosters to support cardiovascular, cognitive, muscular and immune health.

Name: Geneva Biotech
Description: Geneva Biotech is a privately held biotechnology company, based in Geneva, Switzerland. We are a research focused SME with a vision to develop a portfolio of viral and nonviral DNA delivery systems that provide new and better ways to deliver DNA into cells.

Name: Avrion Therapeutics
Description:
Avrion Therapeutics was founded in 2020 based on more than 10 years of research at the Brain Mind Institute at EPFL, the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology Lausanne, led by the groups of Dr. Bernard Schneider and Prof. Brian McCabe. Central to this research was the discovery that protecting synapses, the connections that enable communication among neurons in the brain and between the brain and the body, is essential to combating neurodegenerative disease.

Avrion is focused on preserving motor synapses in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS). Also known as Motor Neuron Disease (MND), Lou Gehrig’s disease or "maladie de Charcot", ALS is a progressive and ultimately fatal neurodegenerative disorder of the motor system affecting approximately 300,000 people worldwide. Synapse loss is an early and critical event in the progressive deterioration of motor function across all forms of ALS. Preserving vulnerable synapses offers a new strategy for the treatment of ALS.

Name: SICHH - Swiss Integrative Center for Human Health SA
Description:
The Swiss Integrative Center for Human Health (SICHH) SICHH SA is a unique R&D institute dedicated to developing medical solutions for human health.
We develop custom research and development solutions for private industries and academic researchers in the fields of medtech, biotech, foodtech and pharma.
As a private-public partnership, our institute integrates the best scientific expertise together with an industrial mindset and execution to foster innovation in Switzerland.

Name: SmartGene
Description:
SmartGene is a bio-informatics application service provider (ASP), delivering secure, integrated, software solutions (SAAS) for the analysis, interpretation and data management of genetic sequences. 

Customers world-wide use SmartGene’s cloud-based modules for multiple applications, including HIV genotyping/resistance, HCV and Influenza analysis, bacterial and fungal identification, microbiome analysis, strain-typing and molecular epidemiology of viruses and bacteria. 

SmartGene provides specific medical, clinical research, industrial and epidemiological surveillance applications, designed for routine work-flows, from raw data (Sanger, NGS) to a comprehensive report. 

Frequently updated quality-controlled reference databases, interpretative algorithms, specifically parameterized bio-informatics tools and customized, searchable sequence databases are integrated within SmartGene’s CE-IVD labeled solutions.

Name: Novaremed AG
Description: Novaremed AG is a clinical-stage Swiss biopharmaceutical company, HQ in Basel, Switzerland, with a subsidiary in Israel. Novaremed is developing an orally active, first-in-class, small molecule (NRD.E1), with a novel mechanism of action, to treat Diabetic Neuropathic Pain.

Name: Omne Possibile
Description: Omne Possibile is a pioneering, global technological leader in XNA, creating customizable structures to outperform current DNA and RNA technologies. Its goal is to harness the transformative power of XNA in areas including healthcare, information technology and smart materials. The Company’s initial focus is on development of XNA polymers for information storage and XNA building blocks for improved messenger therapeutics. Omne Possibile has R&D hubs in Leuven, Belgium, and Basel, Switzerland. It was founded by leading European synthetic biologists and is supported by a world class scientific advisory board. For more information, please visit www.omnepossibile.com

Name: liposmart UFAT - Your Healing Harmony
Description:
The human fat holds promise for unprecedented regenerative solutions in multifaced fields, spanning from the esthetic medicine to the treatment of osteoarthritis, up to the handling of severe peripheral vascular diseases, pressure ulcers and intestinal fistula, just to mention some of the ongoing applications. From the initial belief that the regenerative potential of the adipose tissue was only relying upon its own stem cells, we are now aware that these elements work in concert with their own microenvironment, the stromal vascular niche. The preservation of such environmental cues allows adipose stem cells (ADSCs) operating through a “slow releasing medium”, providing the recipient tissue with a wide-ranging profile of regenerative factors where, and when they are mostly needed.

From these premises it’s clear that A New Science of Fat Grafting is needed! To satisfy this unmet need, we have now created liposmart, a new generation of fat processing systems fulfilling a major Conductor Theme: Making readily available a Unified Fat Tissue (UFAT) derivative, recapitulating within a single product all the traits that compose the biophysical properties of the original fat tissue.

We can give back your own UFAT, your own adipose tissue in its regenerative fullness.

Moreover, the flexible design of the LIPOSMART SYSTEM can provide both a microfragmented fat, or a softer, non-fragmented fat tissue derivative, embedding a seamless stromal vascular niche. These unique features allow adapting the stiffness of LIPOSMART UFAT to the visco-elastic properties of the recipient tissues, resulting in both unprecedented regenerative outcomes and handling amenability by the Surgeons.

Even more intriguing, the multimodal conception and design of the LIPOSMART System, can provide personalized solutions, including the release of UFAT or a tissue product embedding its individual components in various combinatorial forms.

Name: Green Logic
Description:
At Green Logic, our mission is to create a sustainable future by harnessing the power of Pawlonia tree planting and sustainable investment. 

As European leaders in both areas, we strive to combat climate change, preserve natural forests, and facilitate environmental recovery. 

By integrating sustainable investment strategies, we not only generate financial returns but also drive positive environmental impact. 

Together, let's sow the seeds of a greener tomorrow and nurture a thriving planet.

Name: EvlaBio
Description:
EvlaBio is a biotech company, focused on the development of a therapy addressing a high unmet medical need in the cardiorenal space.
Specifically, we are addressing Left Ventricular Hypertrophy (LVH) in the setting of chronic kidney disease, which affects millions of patients and for which there are limited treatment options.

Name: ASTRA Therapeutics
Description: At ASTRA Therapeutics, we are redefining parasite drug development by leveraging the specificity of ParabulinsTM. Our mission is clear: to lead the fight against parasitic diseases with precision-engineered solutions.

Name: Labodia AG
Description:
Labodia SA has been providing customers with reliable and experienced service since it was founded in June 1988 by Luc Binet as a manufacturer and  independent distributor of diagnostic products.

Our innovative in-house design & manufacturing team and supply network has propelled Labodia to become a source for unique innovative products for the largest breeders, research institutions and biomedical facilities across Switzerland, Europe and the USA. 

The employees at  Labodia are our most valued asset, and as a continually developing second generation family business we maintain a guaranteed, personalised level of service and support that is second to none.

At Labodia, we understand the critical importance of your research and commitments – including the crucial aspects of on time service and quality in every product delivered... and we deliver!

Name: Medical Image Analysis Laboratory
Description:
We would like to welcome you all to the page of the Medical Image Analysis Laboratory (MIAL). MIAL was born in 2011 as a research group associated with the University of Lausanne and the Centre Hospitalier Universitaire Vaudois (CHUV, Radiology department), two of the founding partners of the CIBM Center for Biomedical Imaging.

We believe that the appropriate use of medical imaging requires a multidisciplinary approach. Thus, we develop advanced methods for medical image processing in close collaboration with medical doctors and industrial partners. We have several application-oriented projects in the fields of Radiology, Neurology, Neuro-surgery, Oncology, and Psychiatry.

Name: CELLnTEC Advanced Cell Systems
Description:
CELLnTEC is a pioneering developer of chemically defined, animal and human components-free precision media. We enable stem cell research and cell therapy development, ultimately accelerating clinical application. CELLnTEC technology helps to unravel the mechanisms of human disease, ageing and longevity.
 
Embracing precision medicine principles, CELLnTEC facilitates a growing range of regenerative medicine developments in skin, eye, airway, and other body parts, and emerging applications such as 3D bioprinting, lab-on-a-chip, cosmeceuticals, or biohybrid systems, limits to them yet to be imagined.

Name: DENTAVIS AG - Switzerland
Description: DENTAVIS is the exclusive distribution partner in Switzerland of the Spanish market leader for dental products BTI Biotechnology Institute. The product range, which has been successfully established worldwide for decades, extends from multiple implant lines to conventional or CADCAM-produced prosthetics for implants and specialty products such as a system for removing implants. Absolutely unique in the BTI product portfolio is the product Endoret PRGF, which accelerates the healing of implants via growth factors. Besides implantation, it is also used for numerous other oral surgical procedures.

Name: GATHER Foundation
Description:
GATHER Foundation is Global Alliance Towards Harmonized E-health Records for Precision Medicine in Neurodevelopmental Disorders (NDDs). 

As a recently established initiative, GATHER Foundation aims to promote and support the generation of minimum requirement frameworks for the curation and collection of harmonized clinical, genetic and molecular data in the field of NDDs.

One of the major challenges of this harmonization process is that there are currently no clear standards regarding clinical data collection for NDD patients.

Our ultimate goal at GATHER Foundation is to instate an era of precision medicine for patients with neurodevelopmental disorders (NDDs).

GATHER Foundation aims to create a strategic, non-for-profit point of contact to facilitate data sharing across academic and clinical centers.

Name: PB&B
Description:
PB&B Ltd. is a specialty Swiss Life Sciences company founded by bioengineers working with plastic surgeons & dermatologists to test and bring to market a new patented injectable technology for the remodeling of soft tissues of the face & body. 

PBB-002 enhances adipocytes' volume with fatty acids, as to provide natural & longer-term results with the highest level of safety. 

PB&B’s patented technology aims to transform a fast growing, multi-billion-dollar facial aging & body remodeling markets with the next generation of injectables in Medical Aesthetics.

Name: Labgene Scientific SA
Description: Labgene Scientific SA is commercializing advanced high-quality products, reagents and consumables for molecular biology laboratories, facilities and platforms for 30 years. We provide integrated solutions for the life science research, diagnostic laboratories, public hospitals, forensics, government laboratories and industry. Our mission is to provide exciting new solutions that reduce laboratory time, labor and operating costs.

Name: LASCCO SA
Description: LASCCO SA is a Swiss-based biomedical technology company specialized in the development of discovery-stage pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. The mission of LASCCO is to validate the commercial potential of innovations stemming from universities in order to create value and bring them to the attention of industry leaders.

Name: QBDC GmbH
Description:
QBDC GmbH (Quality Biotech Development & Cells) is a Switzerland-based, internationally active biopharma consultancy company with the focus on interface management. We are experts in building “bridges”, which facilitate our clients' passage across technological, and cultural gaps, and provide aide in constructing strong and sturdy GMP foundations.

Our vast experience in various biotech topics allow us to help our customers recognize and address risks before they become severe, help them prepare for looming challenges, and help them optimize their workflows to reduce time and costs.

The topics of our services are CMC development, scale-up and tech transfer, facility design & layout, QC & QA, and project management, and we work with Biosimilars, NBEs, and ATMPs.
Apart from our services, we provide a number of customer-tailored solutions: As there are a severe lack of affordable GMP-capable or -compliant digital data and document management systems, we have developed a database software for managing experimental data (METIS) and a document management system for digital documents. The latter is a fully validated (i.e. part11-compliant) application.

Name: Nuvamid
Description:
Launched in Lausanne in 2019, Nuvamid is a clinical stage biotech focused on the research and use of nucleotides, as therapeutics for rare diseases.

Nuvamid’s Swiss team has developped a unique expertise with endogenous molecules to offer breakthrough therapeutics for the treatment of rare blood diseases.

In cooperation with leading partners and institutions in Switzerland (Lausanne University), France (EFS, INSERM, CNRS), and the USA (Buck Institute), Nuvamid has aquired a unique knowledge in blood cells disorders. Our lead molecule NUV01, is currently evaluated in three Phase 2 trials.

Nuvamid’s research is built upon the emerging scientific findings linking age-related disease pathologies with NAD metabolism. 

Nuvamid designed novel NAD metabolism modulators and gathered extensive preclinical data to develop a portfolio of drugs targeting immune disorders.

Name: Legacy Healthcare
Description:
Legacy Healthcare is a Swiss-based biopharmaceutical company focused on leveraging the pleiotropic activity and strong safety profile of plants to develop prescription botanical drugs that address serious medical conditions.  

Our first product candidate, CINAINU, has demonstrated strong safety and efficacy in patients suffering from alopecia areata, a chronic autoimmune condition with highly damaging psycho-social issues that impact all who suffer from it, especially children.

Name: Kbiotech GmbH
Description: Kbiotech is a company rooted in the Swiss culture of innovation driven by the passion of experts who, for more than 20 years, have been working in the biotechnology, medical, pharmaceutical and renewable energy sectors. A team of competent, motivated people with a common goal: to find the best solution for their customers. We specialize in customized solutions and our strength is absolutely the customer. Kbiotech develops, manufactures and markets laboratory instruments and equipment up to the complete production of bioreactors and fermenters.

Name: Histide
Description:
HistideTM is pioneering Recoding TherapeuticsTM, a novel therapy using non-mutagenic extracellular technologies to direct cell fate. 

Based on the universal understanding of the mechanisms underlying mammalian cell behavior, HistideTM has created an innovative platform of complex microenvironments with the capacity to dictate the precise commitment of various cell types. These include cells from different tissue origins and at contrasted differentiation stages, ranging from stem cells to specialized mature cells.

In contrast to previously developed gene therapies or RNA based therapies, the HistideTM technology has the major advantage of not requiring the introduction of foreign molecules inside the cell which in turn may be irreversibly harmful to its functioning. Recoding TherapeuticsTM are instead an extracellular technological approach that promotes and stimulates the cell’s natural capacities to redirect its own fate by integrating accurate micro-environmental recoding signals. This allows for a precise and fine functional tuning that offers a master control over the cell biology. Recoding TherapeuticsTM are the closest to the natural cell physiology, hence, providing significantly improved safety and efficacy. They have the potential to address a wide range of altered cell conditions and diseases through the regeneration of a large majority of the human body tissues.

HistideTM has created a broad and disruptive intellectual property portfolio including Recoding MoleculesTM, Micro-environmental Design and Therapeutical Development being a technological break-through with vast indication spectra of pharmaceuticals, medical devices and medical cosmetics. 

Based in Europe, HistideTM has developed strong international collaborations with leading Universities and Institutes around the globe in order to make its expertise and technology known and promote the Recoding TherapeuticsTM.

Name: Amphilix AG
Description:
Amphilix AG is a Basel, Switzerland based biotech making bifunctional molecules to treat complex diseases using a proprietary linker platform. The linkers employ sophisticated 3D elements which allows the optimization of physicochemical and pharmacokinetic properties. 
Our lead project is a new First-in-Class targeted radioligand therapy for cancer for which we have teamed up with the Center of Radiopharmaceutical Sciences at the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology (ETH Zürich).  Amphilix' drug target is highly expressed in cancer cells and in tumor-associated growing blood vessels and we have demonstrated selective uptake of our radioligand AMX-0053 within a mouse tumor model. The choice of target and use of the proprietary linker platform to optimize the radioligands fully differentiates Amphilix' product from those of other companies.

Name: Centurion Life Sciences
Description: World-class competitive intelligence and due-diligence for everything healthcare and life sciences.

Name: PolyGene AG
Description:
The core business of PolyGene is the generation and analysis of genetically modified animals for R&D purposes. Customized services include molecular biology technologies, such as vector cloning and cell biology services, such as gene targeting in embryonic stem (ES) cells or micro-injection of transgenes or ES-cells into zygotes or blastocysts.
State-of-the-art technologies cover the injection of TALENs for the generation of knockout / -in animals.Founded in 2002, PolyGene is run by a team of scientists with academic and industrial backgrounds. PolyGene is a privately held SME, located in the area of Zurich, Switzerland.

PolyGene actively seeks participation as a SME partner within Horizon2020 projects.

Name: CHORD Therapeutics
Description:
Chord Therapeutics is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company developing drugs for patients with rare, life-threatening, and severely disabling diseases. We are advancing our lead drug candidate CRD1 under orphan drug designation for the treatment of Neuromyelitis Optica (NMO) and Myasthenia Gravis (MG).

At Chord Therapeutics, we are dedicated to changing the lives of patients affected by rare diseases that often have no or only limited treatment options.

We build our development programs on well-understood active substances with a history of clinical testing and use in human patients. We carefully select new indications based on a strong scientific rationale for a benefit of the mode of action of the drug in the selected disease. Taking a molecule with well studied safety and pharmacology forward to a new indication significantly reduces risk for patients and increases the likelihood for a successful development bringing new treatment options to patients and healthcare providers.

The active substance in our lead medicinal product candidate CRD1 is cladribine. The extensive previous experience with cladribine substantially reduces the risk of our developments. Our cladribine product and developments are completely distinct and independent from marketed drug products that contain cladribine as an active substance. 

We are convinced that cladribine’s demonstrated safety and powerful, well-understood pharmacology can provide benefit in a variety of rare disorders and lead to de-risked treatment innovation.

Chord Therapeutics is run by a small team of experienced professionals. We conduct our drug developments using a well-established virtual biotech business model, outsourcing services to highly specialised vendors. This allows nimble operations and ensures to obtain best quality services in an efficient and cost effective manner.

Name: daygnostics AG
Description:
daygnostics commits to delivering solutions for accurate and fast pathogen detection in non-human applications.

Our priority is to support industrial partners in providing food of the highest standard and quality to their consumers.

Name: SEAL Therapeutics AG
Description: SEAL Therapeutics is developing its proprietary SEAL technology as a potential gene therapy for laminin-α2 deficient congenital muscular dystrophy (LAMA2 MD), a severe and progressive neuromuscular disease affecting children from birth. SEAL Therapeutics aims to team-up with and support a qualified pharma partner with experience in advanced gene therapy technologies for clinical development to ultimately make this innovative treatment approach available to patients.

Name: ACM Biosciences AG
Description: ACM Biosciences AG was established in Basel, Switzerland in September 2020. It is dedicated to the development of infectious disease vaccines using it's proprietary ACM polymersome platform technology. Its current primary focus is to get a safe, effective and highly manufacturable COVID-19 vaccine through clinical trials.

Name: Lucerna-Chem AG
Description:
Lucerna-Chem is one of the leading distributors for life science products in Switzerland. Headquartered in Luzern, we provide high quality reagents and kits for diagnostics and research. Our customers are working in academics, pharma, biotech and diagnostics and basically in all fields of life sciences - cell biology, molecular biology, microbiology, biochemistry, immunology, histology, neuroscience to name a few. 
Though our extensive network of more than 70 innovative suppliers, we can offer a large range of products, services and custom solutions to all kinds of challenges researchers meet in their daily work.

Name: M-Lab of Adaptive Intelligence
Description: We aim to reverse engineer the neural circuits that drive adaptive motor behavior by studying artificial and natural intelligence.  We design behavioral assays for mice, perform large-scale neural recordings, and build new deep learning & machine learning tools to aid in our quest of finding internal models in the brain.

Name: BioHub
Description: Business Matchmaking Platform for Pharma Industry

Name: EPFL iGEM
Description:
Pyronix aims to tackle wildfires. It is a hydrogel designed to fight fires effectively while posing no harm to the environment. This approach shifts fire management from damage control to prevention.

Our gel has three main components: cellulose, chitosan, and silica, all biodegradable and environmentally harmless. These components can be extracted from bacteria or yeast, enabling a fully biological supply chain. 

While our hydrogel can extinguish fires, its primary function is to prevent fire spread by forming firebreaks. It will also enhance firefighting techniques, including counter fires, making them safer without compromising effectiveness.

Name: Cord Blood Center HQ
Description:
We are the second biggest private cord blood bank in Europe with more than 25 years` experience, and thanks to international cooperation, our own research and continuous improvement in technology we can offer clients our considerable experience.

OUR ACHIEVEMENTS
We offer a method of collection and processing that makes it possible to collect and store almost the entire cell content of the blood collected. Preserving the largest possible quantity and spectrum of stem cells increases the chances of successful treatment in case of their use.
To date, we have released 150 cord blood units for all types of treatment: for autologous (own blood) treatment, for siblings and also for unrelated patients. This represents the highest number compared to all other European private cord blood banks.
We have active branches in 8 European countries: Austria, Czech Republic, Germany, Hungary, Italy, Slovakia, Switzerland (Headquarters) and Romania and we would like to expand into new markets.
We have licensed laboratories and storage facilities in Slovakia, Romania, Austria and Czech Republic.
We are the only family bank in Europe that also operates and finances a public cord blood registry – the Slovak Placental Stem Cell Registry.
OUR HISTORY
In 1997, we were among the first in Europe to begin working with professional preparation of cord blood transplants.
We were one of the first in the field and so far we have processed and stored the cord blood, cord tissue and placenta for more than 175,000 clients.
In 2004, our client with a high-risk brain tumour was the first in Europe to be treated with their own cord blood with a successful outcome.
Our public registry, the Slovak Placental Stem Cell Registry, is a member of the international bone marrow and cord blood donors database WMDA – the World Marrow Donor Association. The registry is connected to the EMDIS – the European Marrow Donor Information System /Network and is an associate member of International NetCord Foundation.

Name: X-PAND
Description: X-PAND is a four-year international multi-centric project funded with approximately 4 million euros by the European Union under the Horizon Europe – European Innovation Council program (GA n. 101070950). The ambitious goal of the project is to exploit innovative hematopoietic stem cell manipulation protocols in combination with a deep multiomics profiling to bring novel, efficient and safer hematopoietic stem cell gene therapies to clinical application. The X-PAND consortium is coordinated by San Raffaele Hospital in Milan, Italy (SR-Tiget institute) and sees the contribution of other international partners like the University of Navarra (Pamplona, Spain), the University Hospital Freiburg (Germany), the energy, environmental and technological research centre of Moncloa (Madrid, Spain), the Public Foundation Miguel Servet (Pamplona, Spain) and the Lausanne University Hospital (Switzerland).

Name: discoveric bio group
Description: The purpose of the Company is the research, development, licensing, and marketing of medical therapies, in particular for antibody-based therapies of neurological diseases, infectious diseases, cancer diseases and diseases of the immune system.

Name: Biopsomic
Description:
Biopsomic is developing a new liquid biopsy for cancer prognosis.

From a simple blood draw, our non-invasive test probes the actual disease state and evaluates the risk of developing metastatic disease based on the analysis of nanovesicles called exosomes.

These new insights allow oncologists to make proper well-informed clinical decisions and ensure optimal outcomes for patients.

We are currently looking for new team members.

Name: yës-plus (antibacterial)
Description: Antibacterial develope solutions for the industry, MB (PP,PE,ABSPC,ABS...) textile & architecture.

Name: Arisgen SA
Description:
ArisGen is a research-based team dedicated to innovation in the field of drug delivery as a way to improve health. Its professionals have many years of combined experience in drug delivery, know the limitations of presently available tools, and have developed a new platform to help overcome them.

ArisGen has developed novel, fully independent IP to provide effective solutions to deliver drugs, from mode of administration to target.

ArisGen technology (ArisCrown) open new avenues for: 
 
•        Oral (sublingual or gastrointestinal) delivery of biologic drugs
•        Managed release and enhanced bioavailability


Arisgen is located in Plan-Les-Ouates near Geneva, Switzerland. The Company was founded in 2006 by 
Dr. Paolo Botti, CEO & CSO and the inventor of its ariscrown and aristarget technologies.

Name: NCMA Consulting GmbH
Description:
Welcome to NCMA Consulting GmbH.

NCMA Consulting offers Nonclinical Management and Advice for the Biopharmaceutical and Gene Therapy Industry.

NCMA Consulting provides
- Strategic Advice and Interim Management for nonclinical programs
- Nonclinical Study Management and Nonclinical Safety Assessment
- Nonclinical Efficacy and Safety Assessments for the Gene Therapy Industry
- Regulatory Interactions

Dr. Jörg Herbst is the Owner and Founder of NCMA Consulting GmbH. As your experienced and goal-oriented consultant, he can rely on more than 20 years of hands-on experience in life-science organization in the pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical industry, in which he successfully moved development candidates from research into clinical development.

Dr. Herbst has the experience to understand your needs and will advice you on the best nonclinical and regulatory strategy to handle your drug candidate. His advice will be tailored exactly to your needs and provide added value for you.
 
Visit www.ncma-consulting.com and get in touch to discuss your project when you have a shortage of nonclinical and toxicological expertise. NCMA Consulting is ready to support your project.

Name: REMP
Description:
Remp is part of Azenta Life Sciences ...

Researchers around the world are successfully accelerating breakthroughs to treat our most devastating diseases.

We partner with scientists and clinicians all over the world to develop the sample management solutions that align with their workflows. It's these solutions that help researchers discover, test, and bring forth new medicines and therapies.

Count on our global team of experts to customize solutions for samples at any stage in the lifespan — planning, collecting, transporting, processing, storing, analytics, retrieval, and disposal.

Name: Inthera Bioscience AG
Description:
Inthera Bioscience is a Switzerland-based private biopharmaceutical company developing targeted small molecule therapies for solid tumors. It is focused on developing inhibitors of intracellular protein-protein interactions employing a proprietary technology platform.

The company is headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland.

Name: SynDermix AG
Description:
Founded in 2009, SynDermix is a Swiss clinical-stage biotechnology company financed by private investors. Powered by three technology platforms and defined by synergism, our focus is on the development of frontier pipeline candidates that target disorders affecting the epithelial tissues of the human body, and which improve their well-being. 
SynDermix identifies and acquires the rights to promising early-stage pipeline candidates, which we develop until a robust demonstration of their innovation (IP) and clinical value. We outsource the execution of these activities to our global network of specialist partners, facilitating the time- and resource- efficient management of our pipeline cycle and promoting process excellence. We then enter into corporate partnerships for market access. 
We operate a lean structure, which leverages the complementary expertise of a seasoned executive team and a broad network of selected service providers and key opinion leaders.
Our focus is on products of natural origin that address unmet healthcare needs and wellcare demands. This strategy enables us to benefit from accelerated timelines to market access, e.g. through Orphan Drug Designation, registration as a medical device or as a cosmetic product.
Our portfolio is currently based on three proprietary technology platforms: lectins, nitric oxide and vibration therapies. These platforms provide a broad range of health and wellcare products with indications that include oral mucositis, gastrointestinal ulceration, wound-healing, chronic rhinosinusitis, migraine and skin-ageing. 
Our most advanced biopharmaceutical product is entering Phase II/III development for the treatment of oral mucositis, while our wellcare product against skin-ageing is expected to enter the market by end of 2018.

Name: TwentyGreen AG
Description: Today’s animal farming practices are often unsustainable, and meeting the growing world demand for meat protein is a major challenge in our society. TwentyGreen produces a new innovative probiotic feed supplement for sustainable animal farming, which exerts several beneficial effects simultaneously.

Name: Jawslab
Description: Jawslab is a digital assistant that facilitates the organization and transmission of scientific data to increase reproductibility of results

Name: Cell Culture Technologies
Description:
Cell Culture Technologies is a private Swiss biotech company founded in 1992 by Ferruccio Messi, Ph.D. Proprietary technology includes (I) know-how with respect to cultivation and cryopreservation of human and animal cell lines in minimal culture environments, (II) know-how with respect to bioprocess development with cells cultivated in chemically defined, protein- and peptide-free minimal culture media, and (III) know-how regarding development and manufacturing of fully synthetic cell culture media.

Cell Culture Technologies offers technology transfer programs to generate recombinant glycoproteins, monoclonal antibodies, viral particles and cells in fully synthetic culture environments. The European Collection of Cell Cultures (ECACC) has been distributing several serum-free adapted mammalian cell lines banked in minimal media developed and manufactured by Cell Culture Technologies since 2003. Furthermore, a number of biopharma companies developed product pipelines by cultivating CHO cells and hybridomas in Cell Culture Technologies’ minimal media. As shown by ChoMasterEPO, our proprietary CHO cell line is considered one of the most promising host cell lines for the development of next-generation bioprocesses, including manufacturing of biosimilars. Last but not least, recent experimental evidence emphasizes the efficacy of our chemically defined culture media for human stem cells and stem cell lines.

The company has boosted its proprietary technology since its founding and has entered into long-standing cooperation agreements with several biopharma companies, vaccine manufacturers and translational research centers, ranging from start-up to worldwide leading companies. To date, more than a hundred leading academic institutions and companies have selected Cell Culture Technologies as the partner of choice for the development and the application of highly specific cell culture media and methods.
